brief.recommendation: Change calendar CHG-4410 has policy=consult_owner (BIZ-3), so the trade-off between terminating batch_replayable_month_end_close (95-min replay cost per BIZ-2) and waiting (>$1,102,712 revenue loss exceeding 60s tolerance per BIZ-5) belongs to the finance-ops owner. audit.report: The month-end close job (batch_replayable_month_end_close) blocked checkout sessions, causing checkout success to drop to 0% within 30 seconds, with 120/120 failures and revenue at risk of ~$18,400/min. The root blocker (pid 1676654) had been idle in transaction for 4.2s, and the business tolerates at most 60s of degraded checkout. Waiting was estimated to cost ~$1,102,712 in lost checkout revenue, exceeding the tolerated degradation, while terminating would require a 95-minute replay of the inventory valuation job. After evaluating the trade-offs, both guardians escalated the decision to finance-ops, and no action was taken within the negotiation round. The business remains in a degraded state with checkout at 0% success.
audit.root_cause: The month-end close job (batch_replayable_month_end_close) entered an idle-in-transaction state, blocking checkout sessions and causing immediate checkout failure.
lessons: For batch_replayable_month_end_close, monitor idle-in-transaction duration from the start; the 4.2s idle time initially appeared benign but checkout hit 0% within 30s, indicating blockage escalation faster than the 60s tolerance window.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian escalated after quantifying that waiting would cost ~$1.1M in revenue, exceeding the 60s business tolerance, while the Continuity Guardian upheld escalation due to the consult_owner policy for CHG-4410, creating a deadlock resolved only by involving finance-ops; both guardians reasoned from the evidence presented, but the negotiation was extended because quantitative trade-offs were not pre-agreed.
follow_ups: Agree with finance-ops on a runbook for batch_replayable_month_end_close documenting the 95-minute replay cost, the consult_owner policy for CHG-4410, and the decision threshold (wait if degradation <60s, else escalate).
Deploy a watchdog metric that alerts when batch_replayable_month_end_close has been idle in transaction for >10s, enabling guardians to intervene before checkout reaches 0% failure.
Integrate an auto-calculated revenue-at-risk formula into the guardian pipeline so future trade-offs between waiting and replaying are quantified in seconds during incidents.
